title: Delete or wire up dead _summaryForSection / ComposedDailySchedule.summary — hardcoded-English field is never rendered
rule: AX-2 [P literals] (no hardcoded user-facing strings) / Fowler dead code

evidence.quote: 'tapping toggle switches from flat list to GroupedDailyView', (

why: _summaryForSection builds an unlocalized English string ('N tasks today', 'N missed/overdue tasks', a literal `count == 1 ? 'task' : 'tasks'` ternary) and stores it as the required `summary` field of ComposedDailySchedule. A repo-wide grep shows nothing ever reads `.summary` — GroupedDailyView, the only consumer of ComposedDailySchedule, reads only `.groupedByCurriculum`. It is already flagged in test/e2e/journeys/scheduler_p1_test.dart:929 ('R-SC2 ... Confirmed gap; document but keep test passing') but left in place rather than deleted, and is not listed in coding-standards.md's baselined-gaps section. Because the field is `required` and sits ~90 lines from `_GoalCard`, which properly localizes the near-identical 'N tasks today' string via `l10n.schedulerGoalTaskCount(count)`, a future engineer adding a summary line to GroupedDailyView (which currently has none) would likely reach for the already-there `schedule.summary` and reintroduce, in the he locale, the exact bug class already fixed once in this same file (SCHED-GOAL-PLURAL-15 / SCHED-GOAL-I18N-R2). scheduler_screen_l1_test.dart:538-582 already pumps and toggles into GroupedDailyView for other assertions but — because nothing renders `.summary` — cannot and does not assert anything about it, so this batch's test suite gives zero signal either way.
recommendation: Delete _summaryForSection and the summary field/parameter on ComposedDailySchedule since nothing consumes it. If a grouped-view summary line is actually wanted, route it through AppLocalizations/ARB with ICU plurals matching _GoalCard's pattern, and add a widget-test assertion (both locales) that would fail if it regressed to hardcoded English.
acceptance_criteria: grep -rn '\.summary' lib/features/scheduler returns no hits, or every remaining hit resolves through AppLocalizations.
If kept, a widget test asserts the rendered grouped-view summary text in Locale('he') contains no Latin-script task-count words.
